name: Snapmaker U1
subtitle: 3D printer
description: Four-toolhead 3D printer with a 270 × 270 × 270 mm build volume, 300 °C nozzle, 100 °C bed, and out-of-the-box support for PLA, PETG, TPU, PVA and PCTG.

name: Top cover for the Snapmaker U1
subtitle: Official Snapmaker U1 extension
description: Official enclosure top cover for the Snapmaker U1. Adds passive chamber heating and unlocks the ABS, ASA, PA and PC material profiles.

name: Shelly Plug M Gen3
subtitle: smart socket
description: Wi-Fi smart plug with power monitoring, used to switch and meter the printer, dryer or chamber heater.

name: DJI Mic Mini 2
subtitle: wireless microphone system
description: Compact wireless microphone kit with 11 g transmitters, 48 kHz/24-bit audio, two-level noise cancellation, three voice presets and up to 48 hours of total runtime with the charging case.

name: ArtCraft Suite
subtitle: open-source creative app suite
description: Seventeen native, open-source creative apps built in Rust: image editing, vector illustration, video, audio, motion graphics, 2D animation, page layout, 3D, CAD and more. Free to use, with macOS, Windows and Linux builds.

name: SolidCraft
subtitle: parametric 3D CAD app
description: Open-source parametric CAD app built in Rust. Draw constrained sketches, extrude or revolve them into solids, and edit named parameters in a feature-history timeline; export STEP and mesh files, or drive the model through its optional MCP server. Desktop and browser builds.

name: iPhone 15 Pro
subtitle: smartphone
description: Apple's 2023 flagship iPhone with a titanium frame, A17 Pro chip, 48 MP main camera and USB-C.

name: 3DJake ABS Pastellpink
subtitle: ABS filament
description: Pastel-pink ABS filament from 3DJake's own range, made in the EU and wound on a 1 kg spool. Developed for mechanically loaded parts, with high thermal stability, UL 94 HB flame retardance, electrical insulation and strong layer adhesion. Print at 220–250 °C with a 100–110 °C bed.

name: 3DJake ABS Pastellgrün
subtitle: ABS filament
description: Pastel-green ABS filament from 3DJake's own range, made in the EU and wound on a 1 kg spool. Developed for mechanically loaded parts, with high thermal stability, UL 94 HB flame retardance, low shrinking and strong layer adhesion. Print at 220–250 °C with a 100–110 °C bed.
